decisions.reason: Specifies installation clearances, trimming limits, and threshold heights without requiring a new product.
Requires a tested fire door assembly; its frame, leaf, and hardware are components of the same product.

items.description: Tested system comprising the door frame, leaf, and operating hardware.

decisions.reason: Requires concealed wiring and suitably sized strike plates for future electric strike installation, not the electric strikes themselves.

items.material_name: Electric strike retrofit provision with concealed wiring and sized strike plate
items.description: Prepares framed and tenant entrance doors for later electric strike installation without altering the approved door assembly.

decisions.reason: Requires physical escape-route hardware, with full-panic hardware and door monitoring specified for particular applications.

items.material_name: Escape-route door hardware package with EN 179 lever or EN 1125 panic bar
items.description: Includes full-panic inactive-leaf hardware where required and a release terminal or alarm for doors kept closed.

decisions.reason: Requires physical door closers; adjustment and follow-up servicing do not change the supply requirement.

items.material_name: Aluminium-silver slide-rail overhead door closer with mechanical hold-open
items.description: Fully concealed for timber-framed doors, with fire-alarm-linked free-swing operation where required.

decisions.reason: Explicitly assigns supply and installation of the door hold-open system and its associated components to the contractor.

items.material_name: Fire and smoke door hold-open system, slide-rail integrated, maximum 35 mm height, minimum 117° opening
items.description: Includes smoke detection and manual release; wall-mounted electromagnets are specified for high-load areas.

decisions.reason: Explicitly assigns supply and installation of the door operator, controls, and associated equipment to the contractor.

items.material_name: Low-profile automatic door operator system, height < 70 mm
items.description: Includes a control terminal, sensor strips, and a door opener for double-leaf doors.

decisions.reason: Requires physical door and window hardware in several application-specific configurations, without separately ordered quantities.

items.material_name: Door and window hardware package with round stainless-steel-finish escutcheons and stainless-steel-finish window handles
items.description: Application-specific fittings include lever and lock trim, secured hinges, balcony latches, and lockable tilt-before-turn window hardware.

decisions.reason: Explicitly requires supply and installation of made-to-measure interior window sills.

items.material_name: Maple-effect MDF/HPL interior window sill, 30 × 195 mm
items.description: Prefinished melamine-resin sill with rounded edges, silicone joints, and cutouts as needed for office installation.
